# Line

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Represents a simple line element that can be horizontal or vertical. Useful for visual dividers and structural lines.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new Line()
```

## Properties

- [`Color`](#color): Gets or sets the color of the line.
- [`DashPattern`](#dashpattern): Alternating dash and gap lengths in points.
- [`Length`](#length): Gets or sets the length of the line.
- [`Orientation`](#orientation): Gets or sets the orientation of the line.
- [`Thickness`](#thickness): Gets or sets the thickness of the line in points.

### `Color`

```csharp
Color Color { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the color of the line. Default is Black.

### `DashPattern`

```csharp
float[] DashPattern { get; set; }
```

Alternating dash and gap lengths in points.

> A list you can change.

### `Length`

```csharp
float? Length { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the length of the line. For Horizontal lines, if null (default), it takes the full available width. For Vertical lines, this determines the height. If null, it defaults to a standard height (e.g., 100) or you might want to specify it explicitly as vertical lines in flow layout usually need a height.

### `Orientation`

```csharp
LineOrientation Orientation { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the orientation of the line. Default is Horizontal.

### `Thickness`

```csharp
float Thickness { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the thickness of the line in points. Default is 1.
